```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(modelsummary)
orders <- read_csv("data/ec_orders.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
customers <- read_csv("data/ec_customers.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
spend <- orders |>
  filter(year(order_date) == 2025) |>
  group_by(customer_id) |>
  summarise(sales = sum(qty * unit_price))
cust <- customers |>
  filter(signup_date < ymd("2025-01-01")) |>
  left_join(spend, by = "customer_id") |>
  mutate(sales = replace_na(sales, 0), channel = fct_relevel(channel, "検索"))
m2 <- lm(sales ~ channel + age, data = cust)
```

## Row {height="45%"}

```{r}
#| title: "経路別の平均購入額"
cust |> group_by(channel) |> summarise(sales = mean(sales)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = channel, y = sales)) + geom_col() + labs(x = NULL, y = "円")
```

```{r}
#| title: "購入額の分布"
ggplot(cust, aes(x = channel, y = sales)) + geom_boxplot() + labs(x = NULL, y = "円")
```

## Row {height="55%"}

```{r}
#| title: "回帰（基準は検索経由）"
modelsummary(list("(2)" = m2), vcov = "HC1", gof_map = c("nobs", "r.squared"), fmt = 0)
```
